scope: Independent Node reconstruction of both actual decoded referee GLBs using their joints, inverse binds, skin weights, morph targets and named materials; the exact runtime controller drives the high-detail mesh and its bone/morph snapshots drive LOD1, matching the preview and baked animation authoring. No renderer or GPU is involved.
inputScope: GLB input hashes identify pre-bake generated character templates. Final delivered GLB bytes change when clips are embedded; geometry payload preservation and final staged SHA coverage are checked separately by the bake and authoritative LIVE/BAKED browser skin audits.

baseline.description: Current frozen source evaluated only in memory with denseFallGarment forced false; all other constraints, the preserved sole reference and fixed four projection passes remain identical.

candidate.description: Append every official_trousers vertex to fall body-floor probes once per controller, omit duplicate body extrema for that material, retain existing foot/hand probes and four projection passes.
candidate.affectsOnly: Referee FALL body-floor projection; hold, locomotion, dribbles and the five player roles retain their prior probe sets.

coverage.cause: A fixed set of 26 bind-pose support directions can miss the lowest surface vertex after articulation. The reproduced offender is fully weighted to LeftLeg, so blended weights are not required for the failure.

sharedHighDriverFloorAudit.scan: Every skinned/morphed vertex in every mesh, including actual world transforms.

adaptiveContinuity.description: Source poses compared with coherent local TRS interpolation at interval quarters, midpoint and three-quarter; uniform 30Hz seed, maximum recursion depth 10 and minimum interval 0.1ms.

auxiliaryIndependentLowController.description: Independent LOD1 controller diagnostic, separate from the production high-driver path.

pairedCPU.scope: Desktop Node controller.seek CPU wall time only, after 40 warm-up seeks; 169 deterministic full-cycle phases per variant. No physical-phone measurement, GPU rendering or FPS claim. Other workspace processes were not isolated.

authoritativeBrowserAudit: verification/skin-referee-validation.json independently covers all 27 actions on both LODs at 60Hz.

bakeProvenance.description: The final bake completed while this independent evidence file was being saved. Its referee sourceSha256 values match these pre-bake geometry inputs exactly; delivered GLB SHA256 values differ because the clips are now embedded.
